Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category. Here are worked examples, then the case to code.

Example 1
Hospital course: A 72-year-old man with a 50 pack-year smoking history was admitted with three days of worsening breathlessness and purulent sputum. Spirometry showed an FEV1/FVC ratio of 0.52. He was treated with nebulised bronchodilators, oral prednisolone and antibiotics for an infective exacerbation of his long-standing airflow limitation.
Answer: J44

Example 2
Hospital course: A 58-year-old man presented with crushing central chest pain radiating to the jaw. The electrocardiogram showed ST elevation in the anterior leads and high-sensitivity troponin rose from 40 to 2100 ng/L. He underwent primary percutaneous coronary intervention with a stent to the proximal left anterior descending artery.
Answer: I21

Example 3
Hospital course: A 34-year-old woman presented with fever, rigors, dysuria and right flank tenderness. Urine microscopy showed pyuria and culture grew Escherichia coli. Computed tomography showed a swollen right kidney with no abscess. She improved on intravenous ceftriaxone.
Answer: N10

Hospital Course:
The patient was admitted for chest pain and dyspnea on exertion of one-day duration. Initial evaluation with electrocardiogram and left heart catheterization revealed a diagnosis of anterior wall ST segment elevation MI, with 50% stenosis of the proximal LAD, 100% occluded mid LAD with thrombus in place, and 30% in-stent restenosis in the distal LAD. The patient underwent successful drug-eluting stent placement in the mid LAD.

The patient's hospital course was complicated by cardiogenic shock approximately 48 hours following the procedure, requiring intravenous diuresis and inotrope support. The patient was evaluated for advanced heart failure therapies, underwent a thorough evaluation, and planning for LVAD placement with periprocedural anticoagulation using bivalirudin was initiated. The patient was eventually discharged to a cardiac rehabilitation center.

The patient was also instructed to maintain a heart-healthy diet, avoid smoking and excessive alcohol intake, and engage in regular exercise as tolerated.
